blocks.html: Buying Intent refers to the degree of interest and readiness a prospect or organization has toward making a purchase. It indicates how likely a potential buyer is to move forward in the decision-making process based on their actions and engagement.

In B2B marketing and sales, buying intent helps teams identify which prospects are actively researching or evaluating solutions. Instead of relying solely on demographic or firmographic data, businesses use intent data to understand real-time interest and prioritize high-potential opportunities.
Buying intent is determined through behavioral signals, such as:

items.html: Downloading whitepapers, case studies, or reports
Searching for relevant keywords or solutions
Engaging with emails, ads, or webinars

blocks.html: These signals are tracked and analyzed using intent data platforms, allowing sales and marketing teams to identify prospects who are closer to making a purchase.
Helps prioritize high-quality leads with a higher likelihood to convert
Improves alignment between sales and marketing teams
Enables more personalized and timely outreach
Shortens the sales cycle by targeting ready-to-buy prospects
Increases conversion rates and overall ROI

A SaaS company notices that a target account has repeatedly visited its pricing page, downloaded a comparison guide, and searched for competitor alternatives. These actions signal strong buying intent, prompting the sales team to reach out with a tailored demo and offer.

Buying intent provides valuable insights into a prospect’s readiness to purchase. By leveraging intent data, businesses can focus their efforts on the right audience at the right time, improving efficiency and driving better sales outcomes.
